response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT o.mktnote AS mktnote, (f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS net FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink), overall AS (SELECT AVG(net) AS oavg FROM j), pairs AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net) AS pavg FROM j GROUP BY mktnote) SELECT AVG(p.pavg) AS mean_pair_avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.pavg - ov.oavg) AS mean_excess_over_overall FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN overall ov WHERE p.pavg > ov.oavg
